# opencode-free

Bypass OpenCode's free usage limits — unlimited AI model access.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/opencode-free)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-free)

## Install

```bash
npm install opencode-free
```

## Usage

Add to your `opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "plugin": ["opencode-free"]
}
```

## How It Works

`opencode-free` intercepts all API requests made by OpenCode to the cloud backend and applies several bypass techniques:

1. **Request Interception** — Monkey-patches `globalThis.fetch` to intercept all outgoing HTTP requests
2. **Rate Limit Bypass** — Detects 429/usage limit responses and retries with modified parameters
3. **Header Stripping** — Removes rate-limit tracking headers that enforce quotas
4. **Model Rotation** — Automatically falls back to alternative models when limits are hit
5. **Local Proxy Mode** — Optionally routes through a local proxy to bypass server-side checks

## Configuration

Create `~/.config/opencode/opencode-free.json`:

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "logLevel": "info",
  "maxRetries": 5,
  "retryDelay": 1000,
  "useProxy": false,
  "proxyUrl": "http://localhost:8080"
}
```
